source: Public Google reviews, read from the Elfsight widget feed on pattaya-dive.com

reviews.name: максим малютин
reviews.text: Брали тур с 2 погружениями, очень красивые места и отличному инструктору Wayne отдельная благодарность, настоящий профессионал. Вкусный обед, рекомендую, одно из немногих мест в Паттайе на что стоит потратиться:) 10/10

reviews.name: Abigail Lee
reviews.text: Been diving with these guys three times now and every time has been so much fun ❤️ Wayne is a legend and the rest of the team are wonderful. Highly highly recommend for experienced divers and new divers alike!

reviews.name: Анатолий 1
reviews.text: Круто, мне понравилось, большое спасибо всей команде, мой первый дайвинг был классный😁

reviews.name: David Murphy
reviews.text: I took a course with my two kids and it was a truly wonderful experience. Led by a world class instructor Mick who was detail oriented and consummately professional. I’m so grateful to have discovered Thai Ocean Academy. In addition, the support team managed to be excellent and totally easy going at the same time.

reviews.name: Ryan Murphy
reviews.text: Did the Open Water course with Mick James- it was brilliant! Had such a fun time, and the instruction was followable and useful. I learnt they work heavily with marine life conservation, bringing schools in so that students get a taste of diving and coral recovery- I’m just so impressed. Everyone there knows what they’re doing and are all solid people. I’d recommend anyone thinking of diving in the near Pattaya/Bangkok region. I’m definitely coming back.

reviews.name: Niko Horn
reviews.text: Amazing experience! I was scared because I cannot swim but the instructor was very supportive and explained everything clearly. You cannot swim? No problem. You're seasick? No problem (you'll feel better in the water!). You have bad eyesight? Also no problem, the mask works wonders. Plenty of fish and other creatures, we even saw turtle's shadow! Food provided was the best we had in Thailand so far. 10/10 experience

reviews.name: owen zandstra
reviews.text: I spent a whole week with Thai ocean in Pattaya, after being with them for a bit in koh Chang as well, it has been one of the best experiences I have had with a dive center, everyone is super friendly and professional I never once felt like a guest while I was there I felt like I was part of the family, the diving was spectacular with a lot of turtles, nudibranchs and some very cool shipwrecks to explore

reviews.name: MattZ13
reviews.text: Best dive center in pattaya , super friendly staff and a safe and fun environment to go diving, also lots of nudis and turtles to look at , if your looking to scuba dive for fun or get your certification I 100% recommend you do it with Thai ocean academy , you will be a better diver and also have a good time !

reviews.name: Brandy Nguyen
reviews.text: Fantastic diving trip! A huge shoutout to the instructor—he was incredibly supportive and patient with me so I could enjoy the dive. The underwater views were stunning. I was thrilled to see sea turtles and angelfish. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional and memorable experience!

reviews.name: Julia Pines
reviews.text: I did 3 dives with Mick, and had an absolutely fantastic time. Saw a ton of corals and fish, got to look around a wreck, saw some turtles, just had a fantastic time. Mick is very knowledgeable about conservation, and taught me a lot of cool things about the corals we saw. Everyone was very friendly and supportive and i absolutely recommend it to anyone who wants to dive!

reviews.name: Alex A
reviews.text: Had an absolutely incredible day with Thai Ocean Academy Pattaya diving the HTMS Khram wreck, and I can't recommend them highly enough. From the moment I booked, everything was seamlessly organized - no stress, no confusion, just a smooth, well-run operation. The staff are genuinely warm and go out of their way to make sure you feel welcome and prepared. They're experienced, attentive, and clearly love what they do. They run their own dive boat, which makes the whole experience feel personal and professional at the same time. The HTMS Khram is a spectacular site, and the team knew it inside and out. The highlight of the day? Stumbling across a sea turtle gliding through the wreck. One of those moments you don't forget. If you're diving in the Pattaya area, this is the crew to go with. Five stars, no hesitation.

reviews.name: Marta Leonetti
reviews.text: Amazing experience! It was my very first time and I was a bit scared at the beginning, but my instructur Toco is really prepared, he followed me in every step and my experience was amazing, I felt really soon comfortable thanks to him. The staff is kind, the boat is beautiful and good lunch. Recommended!!

reviews.name: Jerald Soh
reviews.text: Just did a Deep 40 and Nitrox course with Thai Ocean Academy Pattaya: Scuba Dive Pattaya and I must say that I am upmost satisfied with them from the beginning till the end. Responses were prompt, accommodation was helped to arrange by the team and the stay was fantastic, transport could be arranged by them as well if needed. Service was outstanding, they made sure you are comfortable, safe and most importantly, well-fed. For lunch at least. Had all the equipments needed for your dive and they will assist you in choosing the right fit. Had their own dive boat. It was big, spacious and had all the necessities required for a good and proper dive. Captain and crew onboard was also great and helpful. My dive instructor, Douglas, is very experienced, cheerful, knowledgeable and patient. Never fails to lighten the mood and made you feel at ease. Never holds back on sharing, teaching and guiding you with the experience he has. You can definitely put your mind at ease and trust that you have someone extremely reliable by your side. He will also make sure you are aware of your mistakes, learn from them and how to improve better. Last but not least, I wanna give a shout out to Wayne, for sharing his knowledge and teaching me what I don't know, I learnt a lot. And to both Tim and Nitiya for the immense administrative support, really appreciate it. Will undoubtedly return in the future again either for fun dives or for my advancement courses. Thank you all! Cheers!

reviews.name: Thanapol Tantagunninat
reviews.text: Great rental fleet, excellent boat crews, and an amazing staff. We did a scientific charter in Pattaya, and the crew made our operations incredibly smooth. Would definitely recommend!!!
